modules.name: tb_paxi_tensor_handoff
modules.description: Portless simulation: actual Stem outputs pass through the unchanged single-outstanding bridge and a conditional endpoint before down2

reset.name: ddr_rstn
reset.values: Coordinated bridge/endpoint reset only; live cancellation drains accepted requests

behavior: 36864 writes, poison original tensor, 36864 reads, byte-exact comparison, then all 576 down2 tiles
Explicit endpoint visibility event, never accept AW/W as a commit
constraints: Conditional model, not actual DDR2 controller/chip execution
The interface has no exposed read backpressure; real PAXI does have RREADY
No synthesizable tensor DMA sequencer added
corner_cases: Cancellation before delayed read return and before delayed write visibility
Missing visibility must never release or publish
verification_cases: Normal and deterministic stalled full-tensor paths
